base_commit: main (process after 20261003-016 is merged; rebase onto main)
branch_policy: Create your work branch from main. Push to the branch only. Never push to main, never touch production, never force-push.
constraints: Work on a branch only; report branch name and head commit SHA.
Do NOT modify .env.push or any secret/config file.
Do NOT deploy or restart anything on production.
Follow the about/ tradingtalk/ lab/ page pattern already in the repo (static index.html under a directory, same header/footer).
context: Jun approved promoting both sections to standalone pages. Home #perspectives is fed at build time from the Substack API (landing.py: _SUBSTACK_POSTS_URL, filter title/tags containing '관점', latest 3, cached in perspectives_cache.json). Home #indicators is a hardcoded list of TradingView indicator articles. Today both are anchor scrolls with no shareable URL.
depends_on: 20261003-016 (theme.py should be the styling source for the new pages)
expected_report: Branch name, head commit SHA, test/verify commands + results.
success_criteria: /perspectives/ renders the latest 관점 posts (title, date, summary, link to Substack), at least the 10 most recent; updates without manual edits (build-time generation reusing the existing fetch logic, or equivalent)
/indicators/ renders the full indicator list (same articles as home section, full detail)
Home keeps both sections as teasers: perspectives shows top 3 + link '$ open /perspectives/ →', indicators keeps list + link to /indicators/
Home header nav points to /perspectives/ and /indicators/ (no longer #anchors)
Contract tests extended for the new routes and sitemap URLs; no new test failures vs base
